description: Unit tests for Orleans serialization support for .NET ISerializable interface, including custom objects, structs, and exception serialization, with tests covering callbacks, deserialization, and type resolution.

classes.name: ISerializableTests
classes.description: Unit test class for validating Orleans serialization of ISerializable objects, structs, and exceptions, including callback methods and type resolution strategies.

classes.name: SimpleISerializableObject
classes.description: A test class implementing ISerializable and IDeserializationCallback to verify serialization callbacks and history tracking.

classes.name: SimpleISerializableStruct
classes.description: A struct implementing ISerializable and IDeserializationCallback to verify serialization callbacks and history tracking.

classes.name: BaseException
classes.description: Base class for custom exception testing, supporting serialization info and streaming context.

classes.name: UnserializableConformingException
classes.description: Serializable exception class conforming to ISerializable with additional fields.

classes.name: UnserializableNonConformingException
classes.description: Exception class not conforming to ISerializable, used to test serialization fallback scenarios.

classes.name: BanningTypeResolver
classes.description: Custom type resolver that blocks specific types from resolution for testing.

methods.name: SerializationLoop
methods.description: Performs a complete serialize-deserialize cycle on an object, verifying consistency and logging formatted output.

methods.name: ISerializableObjectWithCallbacks
methods.description: Test verifying correct serialization callbacks execution on a custom ISerializable object.

methods.name: ISerializableStructWithCallbacks
methods.description: Test verifying correct serialization callbacks execution on a custom ISerializable struct.

methods.name: Serialize_UnserializableException
methods.description: Test serializing and deserializing exceptions, including unserializable and conforming subclasses, verifying message and type fidelity.
